_comment: How body parts, like alternative limbs, are generated for each group of body plan slots they may fill. A brief's "slots" pick the group by their names without the side (".L"); only the left side is generated, and the right is its mirror. Its images are painted over a front render of the male mannequin at rest, in its A pose, only inside a mask of the brief's slots grown "maskGrow" pixels outward (a mechanical limb may be bulkier than the arm), never into the rest of the body and never past the line of each outer seam, so the neighboring body stays the mannequin's and the part can join its ring; steered by the render's depth. "prompt" fills in {description} and keeps the rest of the body bare and gray; "guideStrength" and "guideEnd" are how hard the depth steers and for what share of the steps (less lets a part's shape stray further from the arm's); "triangles" is the budget for the fitted mesh. A brief's "fit" replaces any of these. Skin-like areas will tint with the character's skin channel; "palette" is the channel the part's main other tint group takes, like metal or plates, and further groups take the accent.

arm.prompt: its left arm, from the shoulder to the fingertips, is ({description}:1.4), the rest of its body bare smooth gray skin

forearm and hand.prompt: its left forearm and hand, from the elbow to the fingertips, are ({description}:1.4), the rest of its body bare smooth gray skin

forearm.prompt: its left forearm, from the elbow to the wrist, is ({description}:1.4), the rest of its body bare smooth gray skin

hand.prompt: its left hand is ({description}:1.4), the rest of its body bare smooth gray skin

leg.prompt: its left leg, from the hip to the toes, is ({description}:1.4), the rest of its body bare smooth gray skin

lower leg and foot.prompt: its left lower leg and foot, from the knee down, are ({description}:1.4), the rest of its body bare smooth gray skin

shin.prompt: its left shin, from the knee to the ankle, is ({description}:1.4), the rest of its body bare smooth gray skin
